'''Jen Alkier''' was a [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] who went on a mission to [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] to search for the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] mysterious [[Emperor's Vaults|vaults]] after receiving a tip from a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Spy/Legends|informant]]. Several weeks after the agent journeyed to Wild Space, all contact with [[Jen Alkier's ship|Alkier's ship]] was lost and Alkier was designated as a missing agent. Many months later, Alkier's abandoned ship was found on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] with no visible damage apart from a wiped [[Memory bank/Legends|memory core]] and a missing [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jen Alkier is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' in the codex entry for The Emperor's Vaults.<ref name="Codex" />
